payload.title: Member removal revokes the membership row and the person's Cognito refresh tokens
payload.description: Outcome: When Prospectus says a person was removed from the Account that owns a site, Papyrus marks their TenantMembership for that site revoked, deletes their TenantSelection row if it names that site, and calls Cognito AdminUserGlobalSignOut so their refresh tokens stop working (docs/multi-tenancy.md, Session claims, Removal). No removal path exists in code today, so PPY-0bb0fd documents this and implements nothing. Depends on the Prospectus membership events (kanbus-6efecd, task PPY-a1e75a). Acceptance: Gherkin in features_backend: a removed member's next token refresh carries no claim for the site, and the sign-out call is made once per removal. Testing: stubbed Cognito client; no sandbox (D9). Rollout: dark. Releasable on its own: yes. DynamoDB index: none. AppSync authorisation: none.
